headline:
Every business has its way.
Every store has its space.
intro: Explore business categories and a shared space for running stores and serving their customers.
sectorIntro: From restaurants and retail to appointments and services.
directoryIntro: Choose an activity to view its stores.
emptyDesc: Stores will appear here once added and published.
previewDesc: This is the initial interface. Accounts and operational data are not connected yet.
adminIntro: One place to manage activities, stores and platform settings.
notConnectedDesc: Operational statistics will be available once the database is connected.
core: Shared foundations. Your own way of working.
coreIntro: Each store has its identity, branches and team. Operating tools follow its business activity.
next: Next: connect accounts and store data.
loadError: Could not load data. Please retry.
saveError: Could not save. Check the fields and retry.
slugExists: This slug is already used. Choose another.
sharedRules: One message center. Separate payment gateways.
sharedRulesDesc: Platform templates are used by default. Each store can use its own email provider. Store payments stay with that store’s gateway.
subject: Subject
keySaved: Key saved; leave blank to keep it.
emailSetupNote: A provider key and verified sender domain are required for live delivery. Saving does not verify delivery.
paymentSetupNote: These settings belong only to this account. Collection and refunds will be connected to orders and invoices.
inheritedNote: This store uses the platform sender and templates. Enable its own email first to customize messages.
noPaymentInheritance: No fallback to the platform or another store’s gateway.
createFirst: Add the first store to configure its settings.
notAllowed: You do not have platform administration permission.
countryHint: Two-letter country code, such as SA or FR.
currencyHint: Currency code, such as SAR or EUR.
secretRequired: Enter the secret key before enabling.
senderRequired: Enter a valid sender email before enabling.
customRequired: Enable custom email before saving a custom template.
sendTest: Send a test to my email
testSent: The provider accepted the test; check your inbox.
emailMissing: Save an enabled email configuration and sender key first.
providerRejected: The provider rejected the request. Check the key and sender domain.
emailUnknown: Delivery status could not be confirmed. Check the provider log before retrying.
testLimit: The hourly test limit has been reached.
settingsNote: General platform settings apply across the site. Store payment keys are kept separately.
